name: SkeletonTaggers V3
summary: Skeleton Taggers is a wild and fun Gorilla Tag fangame built for players who love chaos, laughter, and social VR. Swing through dynamic maps, tag other gorillas, and explore custom environments with friends. Meet new people, show off custom cosmetics, and enjoy hilarious moments as you climb, jump, and dash around. Whether you’re here to compete, hang out, or just go bananas, Skeleton Taggers delivers non-stop fun and unforgettable VR chaos!
